zh: 账页青梧1列出三笔记录。甲签记着1，乙签记着2，丙签记着3。记录从上到下分占三行，页边画有灰色横线，底部留着空白，背面没有文字。
en: Ledger page Qingwu 1 lists three entries. Tag Jia records 1, tag Yi records 2, and tag Bing records 3. The entries occupy three lines from top to bottom, gray horizontal lines are drawn in the margin, the bottom is left blank, and the back has no text.
